title: Emergency Brake Reset Button
summary: A reset button used to clear a latched emergency brake after operating conditions are met. Emergency braking is activated through the EB position of the master control handle.
purpose: Request an emergency brake reset at standstill with the master handle at N, after acknowledging a vigilance trip if one occurred.
observations: Selecting EB on the master handle activates the emergency brake indication.
Train speed should decrease over time; an emergency command does not instantly stop a moving train.
Traction may be inhibited while the emergency state remains active.
interactions: Select EB on the master handle to request emergency braking.
Observe the emergency indication and deceleration until standstill.
Return the master handle to N, acknowledge vigilance if tripped, then use the separate emergency brake reset button.
safetyNotes: Emergency braking is not used as a substitute for routine service braking.
The teaching exercise permits reset at standstill with N selected; this is not a universal railway procedure.
